spans.s:
नैयग्रोध n. (-धं) The fruit of the Indian fig tree, &c.
 E. न्यग्रोध the fig
tree, &c. and अण् aff.

नैयङ्कव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Made of the skin, &c. of the deer, called न्यङ्कु E.
न्यङ्कु and अण् aff.

नैयत्य n. (-त्यं) Self-government or subjugation.
 E. नियत, and ष्यञ् aff.

नैयमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) According to rule, regular, enjoined, E.
नियम, and ठक् aff.

नैयायिक m. (-कः) A logician, a follower of the Nyāya or logical
philosophy.
 E. न्याय the Nyāya system, and ठक् aff.
